constraints.text: The target contains no music, including copied background music.

description.text: An empty railway station platform. The floor is bare tile, with square pillars running along the platform and a track edge beside it. No passengers, staff, or moving figures appear anywhere in the frame. Above the platform, a sign panel is fixed in place and reads 出口 EXIT 07, with the characters and letters clearly legible. The station space is otherwise vacant and still as an off-screen narrator begins speaking.

The station platform remains in view as a train draws away along the track. Its carriages slide toward the distance, the gap between train and platform widening until the last carriage clears the frame. The platform is left bare again, with only tile, pillars, and the track edge visible. A heavy wheel rumble fades with the train, and the off-screen narrator finishes speaking across the departure.
The train draws away from the platform, its carriages sliding along the track toward the distance.
A heavy mechanical rumble from the wheels and undercarriage fades steadily as the train recedes.

soundscape: Quiet station room tone, joined by the receding mechanical rumble of train wheels fading with distance; no music.
